definitions.explanation: A type of sushi roll made with a full sheet of nori seaweed and filled with multiple ingredients, resulting in a thick, round cross-section. A staple of home-made sushi and bento boxes.

examples.japanese: {太巻|ふとま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{節分|せつぶん}→節分：18971_setsubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{太巻|ふとま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{丸|まる}かぶり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a custom of eating a whole thick sushi roll on Setsubun.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→お弁当：02864_obentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{太巻|ふとま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{断面|だんめん}→断面：21317_danmen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧で⟦{喜|よろこ}ばれる→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: If you slice thick sushi rolls and put them in a bento, the colorful cross-section looks nice and people love it.

notes:
USAGE:
{太巻|ふとま}き is contrasted with ⟦{細巻|ほそま}き→細巻き：21366_hosomaki⟧ (thin roll), which uses half a sheet of nori and a single filling. {太巻|ふとま}き typically contains multiple ingredients such as egg, cucumber, kanpyo, and fish.

CULTURAL NOTE:
During ⟦{節分|せつぶん}→節分：18971_setsubun⟧ (February 3), it is customary in many parts of Japan to eat a whole {太巻|ふとま}き called ⟦{恵方巻|えほうまき}→恵方巻：22491_ehoumaki⟧ while facing the lucky direction of the year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {太巻|ふとま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧: to roll a thick sushi roll
- {太巻|ふとま}き{寿司|ずし}: thick-rolled sushi

FORMS:
{太|ふと} (thick) + {巻|ま}き (roll).
